title: Zigzag
description: A responsive poster after the Whitney's W. Five frames share their gutters: four hold a solved W at one stroke weight, and one sets an exhibition line in Geist from the type scale. Drag any gutter and the frames on both sides re-proportion at once. One W goes flat and panoramic while its neighbour goes tall and narrow, every mitre still lands on all four sides of its frame, and the type column re-rags and steps its title size to match. The frames are parted by white alone, a gap half the stroke wide; while a gutter is in hand the Ws beside it step one weight heavier, and settle back when it is let go.
intent: Translate Experimental Jetset's 2013 responsive W for the Whitney: one rule, a line that touches every edge of its frame, makes a mark that fits any format. https://www.designboom.com/design/new-whitney-museum-identity-by-experimental-jetset/
